# A.M.A.L.L.A.T.T.O.U.F

> A.M.A.L.L.A.T.T.O.U.F stands for Advancing Middle-East Allies through Law, Learning, Advocacy, Transparency, Tolerance, Outreach, Unity, and Facts. The site is a pro-Israel resource directory and education hub created by Dr. Joseph G. Rosenberg, a board-certified podiatric surgeon, humanitarian, and lifelong advocate for Israel and the Jewish community.

The site offers a directory of pro-Israel organizations, a blog of commentary and analysis, a podcast, a trivia quiz, and a tool for finding community organizations.

## The 11 pillars

- Advancing: actively strengthening alliances, dialogue, and understanding
- Middle-East: understanding the region's history, cultures, and geopolitics
- Allies: partnerships in security, science, trade, and humanitarian work
- Law: the role of legal frameworks in international relations
- Learning: education as the basis of informed discussion
- Advocacy: lawful, constructive support for ideas and communities
- Transparency: openness, accountability, and access to information
- Tolerance: respect for diverse cultures and religions
- Outreach: building bridges between communities
- Unity: deliberate effort toward shared progress
- Facts: verified information as the anchor of credible dialogue

- [Home and organization directory](https://www.amallattouf.com/): mission, featured resources, and the pro-Israel organization directory
- [About Dr. Rosenberg](https://www.amallattouf.com/about.html): background of the site's founder
- [Blog & Updates](https://www.amallattouf.com/blog.html): latest posts, sourced from the AMALLATTOUF Tumblr
- [Understanding Israel's Security Justifications](https://www.amallattouf.com/blog-post.html): mission essay on Israel's security concerns and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict
- [Global Support for Israel](https://www.amallattouf.com/community.html): analysis of Israel's international support network
- [The Sins of PCRF](https://www.amallattouf.com/PCRF.html): examination of the controversy surrounding PCRF
- [In Memory of David Bergman](https://www.amallattouf.com/inmemory.html): a Holocaust remembrance
- [The Hidden Cost of Tennis](https://www.amallattouf.com/tennis.html): a medical look at how tennis affects the feet, ankles, and joints
- [Community Testimonials](https://www.amallattouf.com/testimonials.html): reader and community testimonials
- [Community Finder](https://www.amallattouf.com/community-finder.html): a tool to find Jewish and pro-Israel community organizations
- [Contact](https://www.amallattouf.com/contact.html): how to reach Dr. Rosenberg
